task: ae.rv: RV32IM assembler, binary codec and emulator
reasoning_summary: Designed the ISA subset, canonical Instr validation and codec first, then wrote literal hand-derived encodings and oracle-based tests before the implementation. The assembler expands li with sign-adjusted lui+addi; the CPU traps on misalignment and range errors. Three runs were needed: compile error, then three test-expectation defects, then green.
